themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations Explode
themes_detail.summary: Park rule violations spiked to 6 complaints this week versus 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 4700% increase (z-score: 17.76)—suggesting a sudden, acute problem at Riverdale parks that warrants urgent investigation into what rule-breaking is occurring and whether enforcement or management gaps are responsible.
evidence: 6 violations reported this week vs. 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 17.76)
4700% spike is statistically extreme and represents the largest anomaly in dataset
CB budget requests repeatedly mention park upgrades and maintenance, suggesting pre-existing infrastructure or management concerns
reporting_angles: What specific park rules are being violated and at which Riverdale parks?
Are Parks Department staffing or enforcement resources insufficient to handle the surge?

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Crisis This Week
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 91 this week versus a 13.4-per-week baseline—a 580% increase (z-score: 7.57)—indicating a rapid deterioration in noise conditions that could signal construction, vendor activity, or new street-level disruptions.
evidence: 91 complaints this week vs. 13.4 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 7.57)
Second-largest spike in dataset; represents acute, new problem affecting daily quality of life
Noise - Residential (1,662 complaints over 90 days) already a top complaint category; this week's spike suggests it is worsening
reporting_angles: What construction, vendor, or street activity triggered the sudden noise surge?
Are specific neighborhoods or corridors in Riverdale/Fieldston more affected than others?

themes_detail.label: Encampment Reports Rise
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 4 this week versus 0.4 per week historically—a 967% increase (z-score: 5.21)—suggesting homelessness or informal settlement issues may be newly emerging or becoming more visible in the district.
evidence: 4 encampment complaints this week vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.21)
967% spike emerged this week; signals rapid, acute change
CB budget requests for foster care housing assistance and youth services suggest longstanding homelessness vulnerability; current spike may reflect downstream effect
reporting_angles: Where are encampments located in Riverdale and what is driving their emergence now?
Are local shelters or social services equipped to address the intake, and what are residents' safety concerns?

themes_detail.label: Elevator Outages Spike
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints rose to 23 last week versus 11.9 per week average—a 94% increase (z-score: 6.31)—pointing to potential infrastructure failures across residential buildings that could trap elderly or disabled residents and reflect a broader maintenance crisis.
evidence: 23 elevator complaints last week vs. 11.9 weekly average (z-score: 6.31)
94% increase signals recent deterioration in building maintenance capacity
Riverdale has aging multi-family housing stock; elevator failures are acute safety/accessibility issue for elderly residents
reporting_angles: Which buildings are experiencing elevator outages and how long have repairs been pending?
Are landlords delaying maintenance, or is there a supply chain issue with parts/technicians?

themes_detail.label: Animal Complaints and Pigeon Issues Spike
themes_detail.summary: Animal-in-park complaints jumped to 4 last week versus 0.4 average (967% increase, z-score: 7.49) and unsanitary pigeon complaints hit 3 versus 0.4 average (700% increase, z-score: 5.42)—together suggesting a pest or wildlife management failure at district parks.
evidence: Animals in park: 4 complaints last week vs. 0.4 average (z-score: 7.49)
Unsanitary pigeon complaints: 3 last week vs. 0.4 average (z-score: 5.42)
Both spikes emerged last week; convergent signal suggests park sanitation and pest control deficiency
reporting_angles: What animals are being reported in parks and are they posing public health risks?
Is Parks Department pest control service insufficient or on a maintenance backlog?
